shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall vertical pillar-like surface
raised outline relief with flat interiors
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief imagery on a tall vertical monolithic surface, and both include a prominent plain disc in relief plus rather ambiguous animal-like forms rendered as raised outlines with flat interiors. The decisive difference is organisation and subject: A is a multi-register narrative frieze of profile animals, a bird, a squatting figure and a zigzag band, whereas B is a single anthropomorphic figure with head, arms converging on the body and a pendant disc, with no registers or profile animal parade.
